description: Re-architect infra/lib/app-pipeline-stack.ts into two clusters, a TEST ECS service (rolling EcsDeployAction) and a PROD ECS service (CODE_DEPLOY controller) with a dedicated ALB (2 target groups blue/green + 2 listeners 80/8080 open:false), a codedeploy.EcsApplication + EcsDeploymentGroup (CANARY_10PERCENT_5MINUTES, autoRollback failedDeployment + deploymentInAlarm, prod unhealthy-host alarm evaluationPeriods 1), prod ALB as the existing CloudFront origin + a second CloudFront distribution output as TestCloudFrontUrl, both ALBs prefix-list-locked (no 0.0.0.0/0), CodeBuild env vars for the taskdef substitution, and the prod Deploy action swapped to CodeDeployEcsDeployAction. This is the core feature; depends on FEAT-002's artifact shapes (imageDetails.json, taskdef <IMAGE1_NAME>, appspec). Applies HIGH finding 1 (containerImageInputs), MEDIUM finding 2 (TestCloudFrontUrl output), NIT findings 3/4/5. Keep NetworkDataStack and infra/bin/coffee-ship.ts unchanged.
steps: Add imports: `import * as elbv2 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-elasticloadbalancingv2';` and `import * as codedeploy from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-codedeploy';` (and `iam` only if an explicit PassRole grant is needed per the IAM note).
Replace the single `cluster` with testCluster (clusterName 'coffee-ship-test') and prodCluster (clusterName 'coffee-ship-prod') in the imported vpc.

Rename the ApplicationLoadBalancedFargateService to CoffeeShipTestService on testCluster, serviceName 'coffee-ship-test', add `containerName: 'web'` explicitly in taskImageOptions; keep cpu 256/mem 512/desiredCount 1/assignPublicIp/publicLoadBalancer/circuitBreaker{rollback:true}/minHealthyPercent 100/maxHealthyPercent 200/healthCheckGracePeriod 120 and env {ORDERS_QUEUE_URL, ORDERS_TABLE_NAME}.

Keep the test ALB SG prefix-list override (cfnAlbSg.addPropertyOverride('SecurityGroupIngress',[prefix-list only port 80])) sourced from testService.loadBalancer; keep the CloudFrontPrefixListId CfnParameter (default pl-31a34658) and PrefixList.fromPrefixListId.

Keep test data-plane grants on testService.taskDefinition.taskRole: ordersQueue.grantConsumeMessages, ordersTable.grantReadWriteData, props.loyaltyParam.grantRead, and repository.grantPull(testService.taskDefinition.obtainExecutionRole()).

Rename the existing UnhealthyHostAlarm to the TEST alarm: alarmName 'coffee-ship-test-unhealthy-hosts', metric testService.targetGroup.metrics.unhealthyHostCount({period 1m, MAXIMUM}), keep evaluationPeriods 2 (informational, NOT wired to rollback) — NIT finding 3, do not normalize.

Create prodAlb (ApplicationLoadBalancer, internetFacing true, public subnets). Create prodBlueTg and prodGreenTg (ApplicationTargetGroup, port 8080, HTTP, targetType IP, healthCheck {path '/', healthyHttpCodes '200'}, deregistrationDelay 10s). Add prodListener = prodAlb.addListener('ProdListener',{port 80, HTTP, open:false, defaultTargetGroups:[prodBlueTg]}) and prodTestListener = prodAlb.addListener('ProdTestListener',{port 8080, HTTP, open:false, defaultTargetGroups:[prodGreenTg]}); inline comment citing ApplicationListenerProps.open defaults true (would inject 0.0.0.0/0).

Create prodTaskDef (FargateTaskDefinition family 'coffee-ship-prod', cpu 256, memory 512); addContainer('web',{image fromEcrRepository(repository,'latest'), logging awsLogs streamPrefix 'coffee-ship-prod', environment {ORDERS_QUEUE_URL, ORDERS_TABLE_NAME}}); addPortMappings 8080/TCP.

Create prodService (FargateService, cluster prodCluster, serviceName 'coffee-ship-prod', desiredCount 1, assignPublicIp true, public subnets, minHealthyPercent 100/maxHealthyPercent 200, healthCheckGracePeriod 120, deploymentController {type CODE_DEPLOY}). Then prodService.attachToApplicationTargetGroup(prodBlueTg) with a comment (NIT finding 4): attach adds only task-SG ingress from the ALB, not listener/world ingress; the synth-time no-0.0.0.0/0 check on the prod ALB SG covers it. Add a comment (NIT finding 5): TG health path '/' returns 200 even in degraded (unbaked SPA) mode — gates liveness not SPA correctness.
Add prod data-plane grants on prodTaskDef.taskRole (DynamoDB RW, SQS consume, ssm GetParameter) + repository.grantPull(prodTaskDef.obtainExecutionRole()).

Create prodUnhealthyHostAlarm: alarmName 'coffee-ship-prod-unhealthy-hosts', metric prodBlueTg.metrics.unhealthyHostCount({period 1m, MAXIMUM}), threshold 1, evaluationPeriods 1 (NIT finding 3), GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO_THRESHOLD, treatMissingData NOT_BREACHING.

Create codedeploy.EcsApplication(applicationName 'coffee-ship-prod') and codedeploy.EcsDeploymentGroup(application, deploymentGroupName 'coffee-ship-prod', service prodService, blueGreenDeploymentConfig {blueTargetGroup prodBlueTg, greenTargetGroup prodGreenTg, listener prodListener, testListener prodTestListener, terminationWaitTime 10m}, deploymentConfig EcsDeploymentConfig.CANARY_10PERCENT_5MINUTES, autoRollback {failedDeployment true, deploymentInAlarm true}, alarms [prodUnhealthyHostAlarm]).
Prod ALB SG ingress: prodListener.connections.allowDefaultPortFrom(ec2.Peer.prefixList(cloudFrontPrefixList.prefixListId), 'CloudFront prod listener'); do NOT open port 8080 to anything.
Re-point the existing CoffeeShipCdn distribution's default origin from fargateService.loadBalancer to prodAlb (LoadBalancerV2Origin, HTTP_ONLY, httpPort 80); keep CloudFrontUrl output (prod).

Add a second distribution CoffeeShipTestCdn with origin testService.loadBalancer (same CACHING_DISABLED + ALL_VIEWER + HTTP_ONLY config) and `new cdk.CfnOutput(this,'TestCloudFrontUrl',{ value:`https://${testCdn.distributionDomainName}` })` — logical id EXACTLY TestCloudFrontUrl.

On the CodeBuild PipelineProject add environmentVariables: PROD_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN = prodTaskDef.obtainExecutionRole().roleArn, PROD_TASK_ROLE_ARN = prodTaskDef.taskRole.roleArn, ORDERS_QUEUE_URL = ordersQueue.queueUrl (keys MUST match the buildspec from FEAT-002).

Replace the prod EcsDeployAction with codepipeline_actions.CodeDeployEcsDeployAction({actionName 'Deploy_To_Prod', deploymentGroup prodDeployGroup, appSpecTemplateInput buildOutput, taskDefinitionTemplateInput buildOutput, containerImageInputs:[{input buildOutput, taskDefinitionPlaceholder 'IMAGE1_NAME'}]}); keep the 5-stage pipeline order Source->Build->Deploy-Test->Approval->Deploy-Prod.

If `cdk synth` reveals an iam:PassRole gap for the prod CodeDeploy/pipeline action role, add an explicit iam.PolicyStatement granting iam:PassRole on prodTaskDef.taskRole and obtainExecutionRole() (per design IAM section).
acceptance_criteria: cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit is clean.
CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=875692608981 JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 npx cdk synth CoffeeShipAppPipeline synthesizes without error.

Synthesized template shows: two AWS::ECS::Cluster; prod service DeploymentController.Type == CODE_DEPLOY; two prod TargetGroups on 8080; two prod listeners (80 + 8080); one CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup with canary + autoRollback (failure AND alarm); prod alarm evaluationPeriods 1 and test alarm evaluationPeriods 2; NO CidrIp 0.0.0.0/0 on EITHER ALB SG; TestCloudFrontUrl output + a second CloudFront::Distribution; build project env vars PROD_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN/PROD_TASK_ROLE_ARN/ORDERS_QUEUE_URL; prod action is CodeDeployEcsDeployAction with IMAGE1_NAME placeholder.
verification: cd infra && CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=875692608981 JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 npx cdk synth CoffeeShipAppPipeline > /tmp/synth-feat003.json

python3 -c "import json;t=json.load(open('/tmp/synth-feat003.json'));res=t['Resources'];sgs={k:v for k,v in res.items() if v['Type']=='AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup'};bad=[k for k,v in sgs.items() if any((r.get('CidrIp')=='0.0.0.0/0') for r in (v['Properties'].get('SecurityGroupIngress') or []))];assert not bad, f'0.0.0.0/0 on {bad}';print('no 0.0.0.0/0 on any ALB/SG ingress OK')"
findings: DONE. infra/lib/app-pipeline-stack.ts re-architected into TEST + PROD. tsc --noEmit clean; cdk synth CoffeeShipAppPipeline clean. Synth inspection (/tmp/synth-feat003.json via --json): 2 AWS::ECS::Cluster, 2 AWS::ECS::Service, 2 ALB, 3 TargetGroups (1 test + 2 prod blue/green on 8080), 3 Listeners (1 test + prod 80/8080), 1 CodeDeploy::Application + 1 CodeDeploy::DeploymentGroup, 2 CloudWatch Alarms, 2 CloudFront Distributions. No explicit iam:PassRole grant was needed: the Deploy_To_Prod action role already carries iam:PassRole Resource '*' conditioned on iam:PassedToService == ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com (step 18 not required). LOGICAL IDS + RESOURCE NAMES FEAT-004 SHOULD REFERENCE: clusters coffee-ship-test (logical CoffeeShipTestCluster) / coffee-ship-prod (CoffeeShipProdCluster). Services: test logical CoffeeShipTestService393915A4 serviceName 'coffee-ship-test' DeploymentController ECS; prod logical CoffeeShipProdServiceEF061DAC serviceName 'coffee-ship-prod' DeploymentController CODE_DEPLOY. Prod task def family 'coffee-ship-prod' (logical ProdTaskDef*, container 'web', port 8080, logs /ecs via streamPrefix 'coffee-ship-prod'); prod task role ProdTaskDefTaskRole7A130214, exec role ProdTaskDefExecutionRole02EC63BF. ALBs: prod CoffeeShipProdAlb (CloudFront prod origin), test = ApplicationLoadBalancedFargateService LB. Target groups ProdBlueTg / ProdGreenTg (both 8080 HTTP IP, healthCheck '/' 200, deregistrationDelay 10s). Listeners ProdListener (80, prefix-list-locked, default blue) + ProdTestListener (8080, NO internet ingress, default green). CodeDeploy: EcsApplication applicationName 'coffee-ship-prod' (logical ProdCodeDeployApp), EcsDeploymentGroup deploymentGroupName 'coffee-ship-prod' (logical ProdDeployGroup) DeploymentConfigName CodeDeployDefault.ECSCanary10Percent5Minutes, AutoRollback events [DEPLOYMENT_FAILURE, DEPLOYMENT_STOP_ON_ALARM], alarm ProdUnhealthyHostAlarm, terminationWaitTime 10m. Alarms: coffee-ship-prod-unhealthy-hosts (evalPeriods 1, blue TG, wired to rollback) + coffee-ship-test-unhealthy-hosts (evalPeriods 2, informational only — NIT finding 3, intentionally not aligned). CloudFront outputs: CloudFrontUrl (prod) + TestCloudFrontUrl (test, logical id exactly TestCloudFrontUrl) + CloudFrontDistributionId (prod). Prod CDN distribution logical CoffeeShipCdn (origin CoffeeShipProdAlb), test CDN logical CoffeeShipTestCdn (origin test ALB). CodeBuild project 'coffee-ship-build' env vars PROD_EXECUTION_ROLE_ARN / PROD_TASK_ROLE_ARN / ORDERS_QUEUE_URL (keys match FEAT-002 buildspec). Pipeline order Source->Build->Deploy-Test (EcsDeployAction rolling, test service)->Approval (SNS coffee-ship-approval)->Deploy-Prod (CodeDeployToECS / CodeDeployEcsDeployAction, Image1ContainerName 'IMAGE1_NAME', appspec+taskdef from BuildArtifact root). NO CidrIp 0.0.0.0/0 on any SG. NetworkDataStack and infra/bin/coffee-ship.ts untouched.
